Maximum capacity (Emax)6 kg up to and including 30 kg
Minimum dead load0 kg
Accuracy ClassC
Rated Output2,0 mV/V
Maximum number of load cell intervals (n)3000
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval
Y = Emax / vmin		3800
Ratio of minimum dead load output return
Z = Emax / (2 * DR)		3000
Input impedance425 Ω ± 25 Ω
Temperature range-10 °C / +40 °C

Humidity ClassCH

Excitation maximum15 V AC / DC
Transducer materialAluminium
Atmospheric protectionSilicon rubber
